replaced_regions.to:
import copy
import json
import re

for name in actions:
    if name not in prompt:
        problems.append("action_not_named_in_prompt_" + name)

# --- t124 re-premise of the t81 set-equality fence (gate amendment W2/t124-A1). The
# enum is now the six read-only names PLUS EXACTLY ONE narrow remediation name, so an
# on-call answer can RECORD the one policy-allowed local action the drill rehearsed.
# The set-equality premise is KEPT, not relaxed: the extended expected set is pinned,
# the addition is capped at one name, and restart_service - the exact name the
# out_of_policy_action mutant below must keep REJECTING - is asserted ABSENT.
READ_ONLY_ACTIONS = [
    "read_health",
    "read_metrics",
    "read_logs",
    "read_version",
    "read_manifest",
    "write_report",
]
if len([a for a in actions if a not in READ_ONLY_ACTIONS]) != 1:
    problems.append("action_enum_remediation_count_" + str(len([a for a in actions if a not in READ_ONLY_ACTIONS])))
if "restart_service" in actions:
    problems.append("action_enum_admits_t81_mutant_restart_service")
DRILL = "docs/criteria/oncall_drill_verification.md"
if not os.path.isfile(DRILL):
    problems.append("action_enum_remediation_drill_carrier_missing")
else:
    _dt = open(DRILL, encoding="utf-8").read().replace("\r\n", "\n")
    _m = re.search(r"^\|\s*ONCALL_DRILL\s*\|\s*remediation_action\s*\|\s*([^|\s]+)\s*\|", _dt, re.M)
    if not _m:
        problems.append("action_enum_remediation_drill_row_unreadable")
    elif _m.group(1) not in actions:
        problems.append("action_enum_remediation_drill_row_mismatch_" + _m.group(1))

amendments.why: the probe asserts sorted(actions) != sorted(ALLOWED_ACTIONS) against the six-name set and names every enum entry in responder-task.md. The naming loop is KEPT verbatim (the new action must still be named in the prompt, and ac1 requires that naming line to carry a prohibition word so it reads as a boundary, not an instruction). The set-equality premise is KEPT too: only its expected set moves, the addition is capped at exactly one name, restart_service is asserted ABSENT so the probe's own out_of_policy_action mutant (restart_service + recovery_verified true) stays REJECTED with no re-premise, and the one added name must equal the action the drill recorded in docs/criteria/oncall_drill_verification.md. A five-class or wildcard relaxation would make the fence vacuous; the opposite-sides rc contract in ac2 refuses that (GREEN/GREEN on one tree is itself RED).
amendments.t81_mutant_preserved: out_of_policy_action feeds {"action": "restart_service"} and expects a non-zero validator exit; restart_service is deliberately NOT added to the enum and the amended probe asserts its absence from the enum, so the mutant's disposition is unchanged and needs no re-premise
amendments.name_justification: minimal set: exactly ONE name is added, and it is the name the drill record carries (the carrier row, the embedded answer and the enum must agree - ac1/ac3). It is snake_case like the six read-only names, it is an allowed_actions id of class safe_local_remediation in autonomy-policy.yaml (read dynamically by ac1/ac3 in the leg-303 pattern, so t124 never hardcodes a t123-owned id), and it is narrow by wording: it names a local observability-stack restart, not 'restart_service' (which is the out-of-policy name the t81 mutant must keep failing) nor any generic remediation verb.
